dogecoin.text: 4️⃣​ ) In 2021, memecoins experienced a boom, with celebrities like @elonmusk tweeting about $DOGE and boosting its price.
3️⃣​ ) After Dogecoin, more memecoins followed: $SHIBA, $PEPE, and many others, turning internet culture into digital assets.
2️⃣​ ) Unlike #Bitcoin, #Dogecoin was never meant to be taken seriously, but its massive success proved that memes could have real financial impact.
1️⃣​ ) It all began with $DOGE in 2013, created as a joke by Billy Markus and Jackson Palmer. Inspired by the #Shiba Inu meme, it quickly gained popularity for its fun, friendly community.
